title: The Numbers Racket
description: The urchin runs numbers slips for the Syndicate to keep from starving — and hates every minute of it. The bank behind the racket is a back room full of Gunsels who'd shoot a child for a short count. He'll walk you to the door if you promise to leave it empty. The sergeant, quietly, agrees the books need burning.
location_hint: The numbers bank, off Ashmoor High Street

objectives.desc: Clear the Gunsels guarding the numbers bank
